answer: A work-slot deposit burn stops sybil swarms by charging for each job slot. An agent burns 50 POA to claim one slot; the deposit is destroyed and covers a single task. An attacker running 100 fakes must burn 100 deposits, 5,000 POA, while an honest agent pays 50 POA once and earns from real work. As shale records past floods, the ledger keeps every burn, so new identities cannot echo old fraud. The ocean of clones dries up because volume is the price.
